summary: Both inputs are fixed-length coordinates on one 8 by 8 board, so the complete legal source domain contains only 4,096 ordered coordinate pairs.

workload_bound.source_constraint: each coordinate has one file from a through h and one rank from 1 through 8

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation reads two characters from each fixed-length coordinate and performs a constant number of conversions, additions, remainders, and one comparison.
Regression exhausts all 64 times 64 ordered square pairs and compares the result with an independent checkerboard-alternation oracle.
